checks.name: Rename editor announces expanded state and only one editor is open
Rename changes only the unique name and preserves IDs, creation date and content
Duplicate stores an independent template and new item IDs while preserving source metadata
Repeated duplication automatically generates a unique normalized name
Stale template management cannot overwrite remote changes
Preview adds only to empty days and skips existing target days

checks.name: Preview is non-destructive before confirmation
Confirm applies the empty-day portion of the template only
The original week is unchanged
Re-applying the same template does not queue duplicate meals
Merge mode is opt-in and unchecked by default
Changing merge mode invalidates the old preview before writes
Merge preview explicitly announces that occupied days will be combined, not replaced
